title: Form 1099-K box 1a gross payment amount statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every personal item sale amount reported in box 1a of a Form 1099-K furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. Closed with members authorizes one statement's Box 1a; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0. Does not authorize a multi-payer sum.
